title: hub and cluster signals
description:
In ideas/context_packs.py (design section 4):
- hub: recently added Reference; degree = current reference edges + shared-concept links weighted 1/sqrt(concept frequency); p-value = 1 - empirical CDF of degree over all site References.
- cluster: connected components of recent References over current edges plus mutual-kNN vector neighbours (k = ceil(sqrt(n)) of the recent indexed set); series = members per day; components with no earlier arrivals are "new", ranked by size x mean pairwise similarity, flagged so the model says "emerging".
- Pack edges distinguish confirmed vs suggested. Anchors: hub lineage, component fingerprint (S1.6).
Tests + Gherkin scenarios.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
